request: Post deployment readback v8 image, start, SHA and health and Vault health; no mutations.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
v=/home/admin1/projects/astera_v8
sha=$(git -C "$v" rev-parse HEAD)
image=$(docker inspect astera-v8 --format '{{.Image}}')
health=$(docker inspect astera-v8 --format '{{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}none{{end}}')
started=$(docker inspect astera-v8 --format '{{.State.StartedAt}}')
vault=$(docker inspect libral-vault-libral-vault-1 --format '{{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}none{{end}}')
body=$(printf 'API_ONLY_V8_DEPLOY_READBACK\nv8_source_sha=%s\nv8_container_image=%s\nv8_container_started=%s\nv8_health=%s\nvault_health=%s\n' "$sha" "$image" "$started" "$health" "$vault")
gh api -X POST repos/G-ACE-inc/server-core/issues/10/comments -f body="$body" --jq '.html_url'
